title: France faces grid bottlenecks, with 10% of territory already saturated
content:

title: Italy’s solar capture price falls below market average in southern regions
content:
Italy’s solar boom is reshaping wholesale power markets, with rising PV generation driving more frequent low-price periods and widening gaps between solar captured prices and average electricity values.
The local PV sector warns that declining solar revenues could accelerate by 2027, highlighting the growing need for storage and hybrid PV-plus-storage solutions.

title: Brazil’s distributed solar fleet achieves 72% average performance ratio
content:
A study presented by Brazil’s grid operator ONS shows that distributed-generation solar PV plants achieve an average performance ratio of 72%, with variations driven by seasonality and soiling. The findings will support new forecasting models to improve grid management as distributed solar capacity continues to expand.

content:

title: EU ROUNDUP: Operators commission 682MWh of BESS in Germany, Estonia, Belgium, Denmark and Bulgaria

title: Australia’s New South Wales grants planning consent for 3.6GWh pumped hydro project at former coal mine

title: Australia’s Transgrid opens pathway for 900MW of grid-forming battery storage as synchronous condenser costs surge 38%
